SELECT EMAIL , AES_DECRYPTION(NAME) AS NAME , AES_DECRYPTION(NICKNAME) AS NICKNAME , TO_CHAR(REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGIST_DATE , TO_CHAR(MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MODIFY_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN , TO_CHAR(LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , LOGIN_YN , SALT , DEL_YN FROM MEMBERS WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{email} || '%'
AND AES_DECRYPTION(NAME) LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND AES_DECRYPTION(NICKNAME) LIKE '%' || #{nickname} || '%'
AND TO_CHAR(REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') LIKE '%' || #{registDate} || '%'
